cover.headline: [6] signs she's wrong for you (spot them [early])
cover.sub: (before she drains your time and energy)

picked.why: Direct eye contact, bold red lipstick, black dress and a confident smile give the attitude and provocative 'baddie' energy that a red-flag warning needs. The owner picks are softer, mysterious or serene, so they fit less well.

slides: 1. She has a high body count

A long list of past men usually means she gives herself away easily. It often comes with constant comparing, less emotional connection and weaker bonding. For a long-term relationship, that's a clear red flag.
2. She has no goals and no self-respect
No ambition, no standards, and she's always waiting for some man to fix her life. A woman with zero direction will drain your energy and pull you down with her.
3. She keeps drama and toxic friends around
Constant fights, attention-seeking and messy friendships. If her life is always chaotic, that chaos will walk into your life too. Women who live in drama keep attracting more of it.
4. She compares you with other guys
“My ex used to…”, “Other men do this…”, “Why can't you be like him?” A woman who keeps comparing you will never fully respect you. Part of her is still dating her options.
5. She has a long list of male “friends”
She's always texting other guys and keeping old options open. If she can't cut off the attention from other men, she doesn't value what she has with you.
6. She only shows up when she needs something
She vanishes while you're busy building your life, then appears the moment she wants money, attention or a favor. A high-value woman adds to your life, she doesn't just take from it.
closing: Save this before you get attached.
caption:
6 signs she's wrong for you, and how to spot them early.

High body count. No goals. Constant drama. Comparing you to other men. Texting her "friends". Only showing up when she needs something.

Which one have you seen?
